method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 敲 Crawfords 家的门，屋里亮着灯却无人应答。
facts.anchor: The lights are on at the Crawfords’, but no one answers when she knocks.

facts.fact: Hattie 双手围住门上玻璃往里窥看，看不到门厅和部分餐厅以外。
facts.anchor: She cups her hands around the door’s glass and peers inside

facts.fact: Hattie 走向海景一侧，一路安慰自己 Wendy 没看到 Tommy。
facts.anchor: Yes, the main thing is she didn’t see Tommy.

facts.fact: 走到后廊，Hattie 看见 Wendy 坐在餐桌远端、一台合上的笔记本前，呆滞不动。
facts.anchor: Wendy is sitting at the far end of the dining room table in front of a closed laptop.

facts.fact: Wendy 说为昨天的事过意不去，带了剩菜来道歉。
facts.anchor: I felt bad about yesterday, so I brought leftovers to apologize.

facts.fact: Wendy 说她听到屋里一声闷响，想起 Sloan，担心 Hattie 出事便进屋查看。
facts.anchor: I started thinking about Sloan and got scared that something happened to you, so I went in.

facts.fact: Wendy 含泪说他们信任 Hattie、把儿子托付给她，随后开始关门。
facts.anchor: We trusted you. Trusted you with him. With our son

facts.fact: Hattie 恳求解释，Wendy 说“不想知道”并关上了门。
